summary: Implement Stripe card payments at store cart checkout using Stripe Checkout redirect, with automatic token-based discounts and order creation after successful payment; restore prior Stripe API key settings.
architectural_notes: Use Stripe Checkout (hosted redirect) for card payments.
Apply token-based discount automatically at checkout (5% per token) with tokens stored on customer account; prevent total from going below zero.
Persist/create order only after Stripe confirms payment success (webhook or post-checkout verification).
Store and reuse Stripe API keys/settings from prior configuration securely (environment/secret storage).
known_issues: AI build/generation repeatedly failing to implement Stripe checkout flow; user reports it worked in earlier versions.

existing_features.title: Enable Stripe card payment checkout from the Store cart by creating a Stripe Checkout Session and redirecting the user to Stripe for payment (do not treat a local form submit as payment success).
Create and store the order only after Stripe payment is confirmed as successful, using the Stripe session status as the source of truth.

Fix the current “Card Payment” flow so it no longer calls savePurchaseOrder directly on submit; instead it must collect buyer details, start Stripe checkout, and defer order creation until payment success verification completes.

Restore and ensure persistence of Stripe settings (test secret key, live secret key, and active mode) in the backend canister, and ensure the Admin > Payments settings UI correctly loads the existing configuration and can update it.
Implement token-based discount and token earning in the Stripe card checkout flow: apply the automatic token discount during checkout calculation, and award bonus tokens only after payment success.

new_feature_requests.summary: Stripe Checkout (redirect) card payment for store cart checkout; create/store order only after Stripe payment success
Token rewards and automatic token-based discount at checkout (5% per token; tokens earned 1 at signup + 1 per item purchased)
Restore previously configured Stripe settings/API keys
